# Spar 0.7.7

**Spar 0.7.7 is a polish release. Menus, tooltips and switches are calmer,
especially in dark mode.**

## Look and feel

- **Quieter menu headings.** Section labels like "Effort" and "Options" are
  smaller and lighter, so they group the items instead of looking like one.
- **Softer edges in dark mode.** Menus, selects, popovers, hover cards and
  tooltips no longer carry a bright outline. They now have a faint edge and a
  shadow you can actually see against a dark background.
- **One look for every popup.** They all share the same edge and shadow, in
  both themes.
- **Tidier separators.** Dividers in menus line up with the item text instead
  of running edge to edge.
- **Switches turn green when on.** In dark mode an on switch used to turn
  white, and its knob nearly disappeared. It's now a green track with a white
  knob in both themes.

## Downloads

| Your machine | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac, Apple silicon | `Spar-0.7.7-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac, Intel | `Spar-0.7.7.dmg` |
| Windows | `Spar-0.7.7-x64.exe` |
| Linux | `Spar-0.7.7-x86_64.AppImage` or `Spar-0.7.7-amd64.deb` |

## Known limits

- This open distribution is unsigned. macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen
  may ask you to approve the first launch of a downloaded installer. Updates
  installed from inside Spar don't ask again.
- Linux AppImage installations can self-update when the runtime supports it;
  `.deb` installations stay managed by the system package manager.
